prompts.prompt: Wide dusk shot of an art-house cinema facade in central Stockholm, warm light spilling from the entrance as a young woman in a denim jacket pauses on the sidewalk to check her phone.
Medium shot inside a small Stockholm cinema lobby, a bearded man in a wool sweater holds a paper ticket beneath a vintage marquee frame, soft natural light from tall windows.
Interior of a classic Stockholm screening room with red velvet seats and ornate ceiling, a single cinema-goer in a dark coat walks down the aisle toward the screen, dim house lights fading.
Close-up of a 35mm film reel spinning in a warm projector beam inside a Stockholm independent cinema, dust motes drifting through the amber light, shallow depth of field.
